text:
Winnipeg arrives on a slide. The Jets are winless in three (0-2-1) after a 2-1 loss at STL two days ago, and they're short Josh Morrissey (wrist, on injured reserve, estimated return Nov. 1) and Vladislav Namestnikov. With Morrissey out, Mario Ferraro has moved in beside DeMelo and Neal Pionk is up to 24:55 a night. Dallas comes in on a three-game winning streak, the latest a 3-2 overtime win over BOS in which Mikko Rantanen scored three goals. The Stars are without Esa Lindell and Oskar Bäck.

The chance numbers are close. At five on five, WPG has taken 46% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) and DAL 51%. Our model has DAL at 3.05 expected goals tonight and WPG at 2.55. Dallas takes 4.0 penalties a game, though, which keeps handing the other side power plays. In net, projected starter Stuart Skinner sits at +3.8 goals saved above expected (saves beyond what the shots should have produced) this season, against +9.3 for Dallas's projected Jake Oettinger. Last season it was +6.0 for Skinner and +2.2 for Oettinger.

Watch Jason Robertson, one point from 500 career points and at 38% to score. Wyatt Johnston is 39% to score and hasn't found the net in seven games despite 3.9 expected goals. For Winnipeg, Kyle Connor is 39% to score. One Ice Sheet under-the-radar pick is Arttu Hyry, a third-line forward with 2.1 expected goals in his last nine games and 4 high-danger shots, at 17% to score.
